workflow:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: GitHub README educational image for a Chinese project titled "Git tips". Generate a polished illustrated developer's notebook infographic, wide landscape about 3:2. Matte warm ivory paper, dark charcoal pen lines, restrained Git-orange and muted teal accents, lots of whitespace, gentle hand-drawn diagram edges but perfectly typeset legible Chinese and monospace commands. No glossy 3D, neon, gradients, dashboard cards, mascots, or watermark. This should feel like an experienced programmer's helpful annotated notebook, not a corporate slide.
Title verbatim: "一次修改，四个位置". Small eyebrow: "Git tips".
Show four clear labeled stations across the page, from left to right, each with a simple drawing of paper sheets, an envelope, a repository stack, or a remote server, respectively. Exact station labels: "工作区", "暂存区", "本地仓库", "远程仓库".
Precise directional arrows: 工作区 -> 暂存区 labeled "git add"; 暂存区 -> 本地仓库 labeled "git commit"; 本地仓库 -> 远程仓库 labeled "git push".
Additional clear return arrows on separate non-crossing routes: 远程仓库 -> 本地仓库 labeled "git fetch" with the note "只更新对象和远程记录"; 本地仓库 -> 暂存区 labeled "git restore --staged" and note "取消暂存，工作区不变"; 暂存区 -> 工作区 labeled "git restore" and warning "覆盖未暂存的修改". Put file restore and unstage arrows below, fetch arrow above. All arrowheads must point to the destination stated. Below the main illustration show one concise annotation verbatim: "提交的是暂存区里的内容。fetch 不会直接修改工作区。"
Preserve exact Git command spelling including double hyphens. Do not add extra commands or extra explanatory prose. Prioritize correct arrows and readable text over decorative detail.
history:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: Chinese Git tips README explanatory image. Generate a beautifully typeset educational notebook infographic on matte warm ivory paper, dark charcoal ink, restrained Git-orange and muted teal accents. Wide landscape about 4:3, crisp large Chinese text and monospace code. Slightly hand-drawn technical lines, generous whitespace, no glossy effects, no dashboard UI, no watermark.
Title verbatim: "merge、rebase、squash，到底差在哪？". Small eyebrow: "Git tips".
Use an initial history strip and three separate illustrated history panels. All connecting lines go from parent on left to child on right. Clear arrowheads; exact graph topology is critical.
INITIAL strip labeled "同一个起点": A -> B (main); A -> C -> D (feature), with C and D on a lower branch.
PANEL 1 heading "merge：保留分叉". Exact code "git merge feature". Graph: A -> B -> M upper row; A -> C -> D lower row; ALSO draw D -> M joining diagonally. M has TWO incoming parent edges, from B and D. main points to M; feature still points to D. Annotation: "M 有两个父提交".
PANEL 2 heading "rebase：重新排队". Exact code "git rebase main". Graph is a single line A -> B -> C′ -> D′. main points to B and feature points to D′. Annotation: "C′、D′ 是新的提交". This is done while on feature. No M or S in this panel.
PANEL 3 heading "squash：只提交结果". Exact code "git merge --squash feature" then "git commit". Graph upper row A -> B -> S. Lower row A -> C -> D (feature). S has ONLY B as its parent: there must be NO line between D and S. main points to S; feature points to D. Annotation: "不记录合并关系，仍需 commit".
Each panel represents an INDEPENDENT result from the initial strip; don't connect the three panels. Don't invent nodes or arrows. Readability and topology take precedence over decoration.
cheatsheet:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Asset type: standalone printable Chinese cheat sheet for the repository "Git tips". Make a tall portrait editorial developer notebook poster with warm ivory paper, very legible dark ink, restrained Git-orange headings and muted teal highlights, spare hand-inked separator lines. No glossy gradients, no corporate dashboard cards, no illustrations behind text, no watermark. Professional typography, generous line height. Highest priority: all text and commands must be exact and readable. Use a clean TWO-column, THREE-row layout, 6 groups, 4 commands per group. Large heading verbatim "Git tips" with subtitle "日常命令速查" and small version note "Git 2.51+".
Render exactly this content, with each command in monospace on its own line and its short Chinese explanation immediately underneath:
GROUP "看清改动"
git status -sb
查看分支与文件状态
git diff
还没暂存的修改
git diff --cached
准备提交的修改
git log --oneline --graph --all
查看提交图
GROUP "选好再提交"
git add -p
逐块选择修改
git add -A
暂存整个仓库的变化
git commit -m "message"
提交暂存内容
git commit --amend --no-edit
改写最后一次提交
GROUP "分支开发"
git switch -c feature
新建并切换分支
git switch main
切换到 main
git merge feature
合并到当前分支
git rebase main
在 main 后重放当前分支
GROUP "远程协作"
git fetch --prune origin
更新远程记录
git pull --ff-only
只允许快进整合
git push -u origin feature
发布分支并设置上游
git push
推送当前分支
GROUP "临时存一下"
git stash push -u -m "WIP"
保存修改与未跟踪文件
git stash list
查看保存记录
git stash apply 'stash@{0}'
恢复内容，保留记录
git stash drop 'stash@{0}'
确认恢复后再删除记录
GROUP "撤销与找回"
git restore --staged -- <file>
取消暂存，保留工作区
git restore -- <file>
丢弃未暂存的修改
git revert <commit>
新增反向提交
git reflog
查找本机引用记录
Footer exact: "<file>、<commit> 需替换为实际值。"
Second footer exact: "restore 会覆盖文件；amend、rebase 会改写历史。执行前先看 diff。"
Use orange to emphasize only dangerous descriptions while keeping explicit warning text. Retain exact hyphens, quotes, braces, and angle brackets. All 24 commands must be present once, aligned and unclipped. No extra commands or extra explanatory text.
